23480858_1f4801fb.text: The so-called interneuron-specific (IS) cells were identified based on direct ultrastructural evidence that some calretinin (CR)- expressing or vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP)-expressing GABAergic cells in the CA1 area of the hippocampus contact interneurons selectively. IS cells were further subdivided into three subtypes with distinct anatomical and neurochemical features.
23480858_1f4801fb.section: Classical Functional and Morphological Interneuron Types

23480858_168cac8a.text: VIP-positive basket cells provided perisomatic inhibition to CA1 pyramidal neurons with the asynchronous GABA release and were not connected with O/A interneurons
